info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Forster Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Forster Syrup Detail Catalog API facilitates the creation of detailed catalogs for Forster Syrup products. This API enables users to define and manage product specifications, enhancing the accuracy and availability of product information. It is particularly useful for manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers in the beverage industry who need to maintain comprehensive product details. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline their cataloging processes, improving inventory management and customer experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details for Forster Syrup. It enables the submission of data that will be stored and processed for further use. Please ensure that all required fields are correctly filled in the request body to avoid errors.
